description: §31.2: a self-recursive client function `walk` calls the server function `down` at each level (nothing calls back). `walk` is client-placed — the pending cell's initializer calls it (§12.2 Trigger 5) — so each `down(n)` is a client call of a server function, handled with `!{}` (§19.9.10). walk(3) = (1+3) + (1+2) + (1+1) = 9. RUNTIME, sqlEngine "real".
rationale: §31.2 (S479): 'A cycle of calls between functions — direct recursion, or mutual recursion … — is recursion, not a dependency cycle. The compiler SHALL NOT reject it.' §12.2 Trigger 5: 'A function with at least one client-classified caller SHALL remain ambient (client-classified).' §19.9.10: 'A call made on the client whose callee is server-placed is a failable call at that site … It SHALL be handled … with a `!{}` handler'.
